Maya: Heads-up 1: post-launch stabilization plan proposal. Suggest a 3-week focused miniwave: week A  urgent regressions/hotfixes, week B  ops mitigations & flags, week C  UX polish + small enhancements. Agree?
Priya: Sounds reasonable. Can we list the must-fix regressions for week A so support and customers know what to expect?
Jon: Top items: 1) Globex relevance regression (ranker score drop causing missing results), 2) a memory leak on runtime v2.1 that shows up under heavy batch. I can triage Globex ranking now.
Sam: Memory leak looks like a garbage collector/tensor cache issue from the new allocator. Might need a rollback if patch is risky.
Ravi: For Globex, I reproduced in staging. Likely an off-by-one in the post-agg scoring path; small patch should restore prior scores. Classify as a bug.
Maya: Good. Bug lane for ranking + memory leak as P0 (customer-impacting across tenants). Any other P1s?
Priya: Support flagged two friction items: (a) modal stuck on large batch requests, (b) inability to toggle fallback precision per team in console. Customers ask for per-team fallback but it's surfaced as a feature ask.
Jon: Per-team fallback can be implemented as an ops toggle (routing rule) quickly. If we implement it as an internal feature flag + API, that's mitigation not a full product spec. Estimate ~1 engineer-week.
Sam: If we do the routing flag approach, we should also add a canary rollout and a monitoring panel for fallback usage and errors. I'll add the dashboard work to week B.
Ravi: For modal stuck issue, I found a stuck promise in front-end when job >5k tokens. I can supply a small fix but UI tests might need updates. Probable P2 enhancement with regression tag.
Maya: Proposed owners: Jon  Globex rank hotfix + validation, Sam  memory leak mitigation + rollback plan, Ravi  modal fix, Priya  customer comms. Week B owners: Sam lead on routing flag + dashboard. Week C: Ravi and UX for polish.
Priya: I'll prepare a customer-facing note for impacted accounts (Globex, Atlas, several SMEs). Also recommending no SLA changes until we validate fixes.
Jon: I'll open PR for ranker fix today. Will include before/after relevance metrics and test vectors. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary for globex-staging?
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for globex-staging at 2024-06-14T09:00Z :rocket:
Sam: For monitoring, adding p95/p99 latency + memory usage by node and a regression alert if relevance delta > 5% vs baseline. Will attach dashboard link to PR.
Maya: Good. Let's have a 30m sync next Monday to confirm blockers and adjust scope. Full retro at end of miniwave. Please keep threads short and tag owners in PRs.
Priya: Quick note  we'll prioritize customer-facing regressions (visibility + SLA impact) over aesthetic enhancements. Thanks all.
